title: Investigation of a Neuroprotective Peptide from Round Scad (Decapterus maruadsi): Bioactivity Validation, Gastrointestinal Digestion Stability, and Structure-Activity Relationship Analysis.
authors: Zhang, Qi; Zhao, Lili; Li, Chen; Chang, Xianhui; Zhu, Lijie; Zhang, Yuan; Ding, Wenping
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋源神经保护肽PPW的消化稳定性与构效关系，核心为肽类生物活性与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate the digestion, transport, biological activities, and structure-activity relationship of round scad (Decapterus maruadsi) peptide Pro-Pro-Trp(PPW) through molecular simulations, in cellular cell model and in vivo experiments. Our results showed that PPW conferred neuroprotection in glutamate-damaged SH-SY5Y cells. PPW was resistant to gastrointestinal digestion and could transport across the Caco-2 cell monolayer via the PepT1 transporter and transcytosis pathway. The physicochemical properties of PPW, including low molecular weight and a high content of hydrophobic amino acids, were beneficial for its stability. Furthermore, PPW attenuated the cognitive decline in sleep-deprived mice, and PPW alleviated oxidative stress and neuroinflammation by activating the Akt/Nrf2 pathway and suppressing the NFkappaB pathway. Quantum chemistry analysis of structure-activity relationships identified the indole group of Trp as a crucial active site for the biological activity of PPW. These findings provide a basis for the application of the round scad peptide as a functional food.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在通过分子模拟、细胞模型及体内实验，探讨圆鲹（Decapterus maruadsi）肽Pro-Pro-Trp（PPW）的消化、转运、生物活性及其构效关系。结果表明，PPW在谷氨酸损伤的SH-SY5Y细胞中具有神经保护作用。PPW对胃肠道消化具有抗性，并能通过PepT1转运体和转胞吞途径穿过Caco-2细胞单层。PPW的理化性质，包括低分子量和疏水性氨基酸含量高，有利于其稳定性。此外，PPW减轻了睡眠剥夺小鼠的认知衰退，并通过激活Akt/Nrf2通路和抑制NFkappaB通路，缓解了氧化应激和神经炎症。量子化学构效关系分析鉴定出Trp的吲哚基团是PPW生物活性的关键活性位点。这些发现为圆鲹肽作为功能性食品的应用提供了基础。
